sources.name: status
sources.cmd: cd {{cwd}} 2>/dev/null || { echo @@nodir; exit 0; }; g='git --no-optional-locks -c core.quotePath=false'; echo "@@home $HOME"; top=$($g rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || { echo @@norepo; exit 0; }; echo "@@top $top"; echo @@status; $g status --porcelain=v2 --branch 2>&1 | awk 'NR<=230{print;next}{n++}END{if(n)print "@@more " n}'; echo @@log; $g log --format='%h%x1f%s%x1f%ct%x1f%an%x1f%D' -n 5 2>/dev/null; echo @@activity; $g reflog --all --format='%ct%x1f%gd%x1f%gs%x1f%h' -n 40 2>/dev/null; true

sources.name: show
sources.cmd:
cd {{cwd}} 2>/dev/null || { echo @@nodir; exit 0; }
g='git --no-optional-locks -c core.quotePath=false -c color.ui=false'
cd "$($g rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" 2>/dev/null || { echo @@bad; exit 0; }
case "$HATCH_ARG" in ''|*[!0-9a-f]*) echo @@bad; exit 0;; esac
c=$($g rev-parse --verify --quiet "$HATCH_ARG^{commit}") || { echo @@bad; exit 0; }
o='-m --first-parent --no-ext-diff --no-textconv -M'
echo @@meta; $g show -s --format='%H%x1f%P%x1f%an%x1f%ct%x1f%D' "$c"
echo @@numstat; $g show --format= $o --numstat -z "$c"
echo; t=$(mktemp) || exit 0; $g show --format= $o "$c" | head -c 40001 >"$t"
[ "$(wc -c <"$t")" -gt 40000 ] && echo @@trunc
echo @@diff; head -c 40000 "$t"; rm -f "$t"
echo; echo @@body; $g show -s --format=%B "$c"
